searchText: MSRP $146,082. New 2027 Coachmen Pixel 1.8RB. Features Convenience Package 30AMP Smart Plug RVQG2800i Gas Generator Thule Crown Awning Rear Screen Side Screen Door Truma G Furnace/Water Heater(No LP) Air Fryer-Convection Microwave Oven Fantastic Fan w/Rain Sensor Removable Induction Cooktop Sumo Spring Suspension Kit Electronics Package LED Lighting 200W Solar Panel W/ Dual Charging USB Ports Ground Effect Lighting Get Away Router JBL Removeable Bluetooth Stereo Upgrade Firestone Tires with Black Wheels Driver & Passenger Upgraded Seat Recovers Tank Heaters for Grey Tank Only Wanderful Rear Bug Screen Wanderful Side Bug Screen More About This RV Adventure doesn't have to come in an oversized package and the Coachmen Pixel proves it. Built on the capable Ram ProMaster chassis with a 3.6L Pentastar V6, this compact Class B camper van delivers confident power and easy maneuverability. Inside, you'll find solid hardwood cabinetry, and a fully equipped galley with a 7.3 cu. ft. refrigerator with pull-out freezer drawer, induction cooktop, and air fryer/convection microwave. Add SumoSprings front and rear for a smoother ride and a 30-amp smart plug for easy hookups, and the Pixel becomes the go-anywhere, stay-anywhere van that turns a free weekend into a real getaway.
